website.readmeExcerpt:
StatusShift

Online status and search comment, shifted by place, job, and clock. Built on Dalamud.

--- ## What it does Rules change your **online status**, optional **search comment**, and optional **slash commands** from zone, housing, duty, job, character, and schedule. Highest priority matching rule wins. Nothing runs on the title screen or character select. ## Features - **Rules by place and job**: world, data center, zone, zone group, house / apartment / FC apartment, duty, job and role. - **Schedule**: Always, Daily, Weekly, or One Time. Days `S M T W T F S`. - **AND / OR / NOT chips**: state, status, mount, emote, accessory, chat, tell-from, nearby player, contains, regex. - **Then set**: online status, command / macro, 60-character search comment (typed or a template). - **When it stops**: Revert (default) or Keep. - **Handling**: Notifications, Selector, Auto, or Off. - **Share**: one rule as `SS1.` code or JSON. Shift-protects replace, archive, and wipe. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ShadowstarIO/XIV/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Status Shift**, and install. Open with `/ss`. Do not also add StatusShift’s own `repo.json`. The same catalog lists LightsOn. Enable **Get plugin testing versions** only if you want test builds. ## First rule 1. `/ss` → **Add Rule**. Name it. Set **priority** (higher number wins). 2. Optional: **Category**, **Character** (`First Last` or `First Last@World`), **Notes**. 3. **During schedule** if it should only run at certain times. Leave Always if not. 4. **If these conditions** — add AND / OR / NOT chips. Empty lists mean any. 5. **Then set / run / update** — status, optional command, optional comment. 6. **When this rule stops matching** — **Revert** or **Keep**. 7. Turn the rule **On**. The header shows the current match. Click it to edit. **Check Now** applies immediately when Handling is not Off. Delete, replace-all, archive, and wipe need **Shift**. A leading `/` on a rule command is optional. `busy on` and `/busy on` both work. ## Handling Set in Settings, on the Selector window, or with `/ss`. | Mode | Action | | --- | --- | | Notifications | Chat / toast / sound when a rule matches. Apply with `/ss apply`. | | Selector | Popup of matching rules. Checkbox enables. Click the **name** to apply. | | Auto | Highest matching rule after the cooldown. | | Off | No checks. | Selector lists every rule that would match right now, on or off. Active on top, Inactive below. ## Commands | Command | Action | | --- | --- | | `/ss` | Open the main window | | `/statusshift` | Alias for `/ss` | | `/ss apply` or `/ss update` | Apply the current match | | `/ss now` | Preview the match, do not apply | | `/ss pause [seconds]` | Pause rules (`120` = two minutes; omit = until resume) | | `/ss resume` | Resume | | `/ss auto` | Handling: Auto | | `/ss notifications` | Handling: Notifications | | `/ss selector` | Handling: Selector | | `/ss off` | Handling: Off | | `/ss zone` | Print current world, zone, housing, job | | `/ss config` | Open Settings | | `/ss help` | Command list | ## Tokens Search comment: `{zone}` `{region}` `{job}` `{world}` `{home}` `{ward}` `{plot}` `{time}`. Commands also: `{teller}` `{targeter}` `{target}` `{dc}`. ## Settings Skip checks while in combat, dead, in duty, cutscene, occupied, between areas, targeting, targeted, or emoting. Set check interval, minimum match time, and Auto cooldown. Comment templates live here. Analysis shows live job, world, DC, zone, housing, and activity flags (blue = true), then which rules match. ## Notes - Does nothing until a character is in the world. Logout does not send revert commands. - If two rules fight, raise the one you want, or add a NOT chip. - FC apartments on a plot use **Zone Ward ## Plot ## Room ##**. Standalone wing apartments do not use plot. - If **Status** is a condition, Then Set status stays **Leave alone**. ## More from me Same catalog: → [Shadowstar XIV plugins](https://github.com/ShadowstarIO/XIV) ## License MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
